entries.name: Dumbbell Sumo Squat
entries.reason: Redrawn on 9 October 2026 at the owner's request, because the earlier drawing was against this text: it was drawn from the side, which cannot show the wide stance or the knees travelling out. Source-bound front-view draft: feet planted wide, both hands on one dumbbell hanging between the legs on long arms; the hips travel straight down between the knees, which go out over the feet, and straight back up. The trunk stays upright and the feet do not move. Not drawn: the turned-out toes, which the front view draws as it draws every foot.
entries.summary: In a wide stance with one dumbbell hanging between the legs, squat straight down between the knees with the torso tall, then drive up through the whole foot.

frames.caption: Take a wide stance with the toes turned out and hold one dumbbell between the legs.
Squat straight down between the knees while the torso stays tall.
Push the knees out over the toes.
Drive through the whole foot with the knees tracking over the toes.
Tall chest, let the dumbbell hang.
